description: Call ANY WEBFLEET.connect action directly (reference guide 1.76). Required: action (e.g. 'showStandStills', 'getObjectKPIs'). Optional: params (object of Webfleet parameters), post (true only for send/insert/updateDestinationOrderExtern). Actions that send or change data (send…, insert…, update…, delete…) act immediately in Webfleet.
name: webfleet_request
